Diego / team —

I ran the annotated workbook and sketched three discrete offers. High-level summary (details in attached PDF):

Option A — Low-friction hosted parity
- 3 months credit applied to token consumption (pilot credit)
- 18% effective first-year discount (volume bands)
- No Dedicated commitment; low SLA (standard hosted)
- Use-case: they keep things simple, minimal ops lift

Option B — Dedicated pilot + onboarding bundle (recommended)
- 6-week Dedicated pilot (2x A100-equivalent capacity) with 30% pilot discount on those pilot hours
- $35k migration engineering credit (applied to professional services line)
- 15% first-year committed consumption discount for a 12-month commit
- Add 40 hours of zero-cost on-call integration support for first 90 days

Option C — Aggressive economic match (requires Exec approval)
- 3 months consumption credit + 20% first-year discount (match incumbent)
- Additional 60 hours onboarding & extended SLA credits (99.9 -> 99.95 target)
- Needs approval from Revenue Ops; expected margin impact 6–8% vs list

Red lines / guardrails: 1) cap onboarding credits to declared onboarding scope; 2) limit early-termination credits to 3 months of committed spend at most; 3) require a MAP within 14 days of signature to start pilot.

Attaching discount_matrix.pdf with modeled IRR and margin delta per option.

—Marissa

Marissa — good sketches. A few tacticals to push this over the line without giving excessive discount: 

- Add performance-based SLA credits instead of upfront dollar credits: e.g., 5% revenue credit per month for SLA misses, capped at 12% year. Low cash impact, high procurement signal.
- Offer a one-time foothold credit (applied as negative invoice) of $25k tied to MAP milestones instead of large open engineering credit. Easier for finance.
- Approval thresholds: AE can approve up to 15% first-year effective discount; anything >15% requires Revenue Ops sign-off; anything >22% requires CRO approval.

I'll create a short summary to paste into HubSpot for approvals. Deal id: DL-2026-1179-CLEAR.

Offer (pilot-first):
- 6-week Dedicated pilot: 2x A100-equivalent capacity with 30% pilot discount on pilot hours
- Consumption credits: 3 months of consumption credit applied to baseline token usage during onboarding (equivalent to X% effective discount in Q1)
- One-time migration credit: $25,000 applied as a negative invoice when MAP milestones are hit
- First-year committed discount: 15% on committed consumption for a 12-month term; step-down thereafter

Why this helps you: it gives a near-term cost parity for pilot and early usage, a committed rate that reduces unit economics vs hosted list, and explicit migration support to reduce lift. It also preserves a runway for Redwood to price responsibly.
